svg.title: Three domains and one resource enforcement boundary
svg.desc: Domain A supplies issuer authority and agent proposals, domain B supplies scoped status and attestation, and domain C verifies authority and freshness at the resource operator. Evidence and status flow to local trust services; execution and closure pass through protected decision and enforcement points. Source: Dr. Carsten Stöcker / Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
